8.4.4 J1939Fscp_Transmit
[CP_SWS_J1939Fscp_90010] Definition of API function J1939Fscp_Transmit
Status: DRAFT
⌈
Service Name
J1939Fscp_Transmit (draft)
Syntax
Std_ReturnType J1939Fscp_Transmit (
PduIdType TxPduId,
const PduInfoType* PduInfoPtr
)
Service ID [hex]
0x49
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant for different PduIds. Non reentrant for the same PduId.
TxPduId
Identifier of the PDU to be transmitted
Parameters (in)
PduInfoPtr
Length of and pointer to the PDU data and pointer to MetaData.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: Transmit request has been accepted.
E_NOT_OK: Transmit request has not been accepted.
Description
Requests transmission of a PDU.
Tags: atp.Status=draft
Available via
J1939Fscp.h
⌋
See Section 7.3.1 for details.
See Section 8.1 for parameter checks.
[CP_SWS_J1939Fscp_00027] Invalid PDU length
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00386, SRS_J1939_00057, SRS_J1939_00062
⌈If development error detection is enabled via J1939FscpDevErrorDetect, the
J1939Fscp shall check that PduInfoPtr->SduLength does not exceed 13 and
matches the configured length of the SDM, and otherwise report the development error
J1939FSCP_E_INVALID_SIZE.⌋
